summary.text: Clint Penzo, a Republican, represents Arkansas Senate District 31, which includes parts of Springdale, Johnson, Tontitown and Elm Springs in Washington County.

paragraphs.text: He was elected to the Senate in 2022 and sworn in on January 9, 2023, after serving in the Arkansas House of Representatives from 2017 through 2022.
Penzo also served on the Tontitown City Council for two years.
He is a University of Arkansas graduate and, according to the legislature's 2025 profile, works as a realtor for Re/Max Associates.
